title: main red: plugin-auth `account-identity-preflight-stored-issuer.test.ts` "over a walk of several pages" times out at 10 s in the hourly full battery (schedule run 40092202961, abdc7f22a5)
body:
Filing gate ①: main red, reproduced in the hourly full battery. Filed by the triage seat (seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:server` seat that owns `packages/plugins/plugin-auth`. One PR, test-only.

## Measured

- **Run:** `CI` schedule run [40092202961](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/40092202961), 12:01Z, on `main` `abdc7f22a5`. Job `Test Core (2/6)` (120867081995), then the aggregate `Test Core`, failed.
- **The one failure,** in `@objectstack/plugin-auth`:
  ```
  FAIL  src/account-identity-preflight-stored-issuer.test.ts > #25030 the verdict does not move > over a walk of several pages, with the colliding rows on its first and last page
  Error: Test timed out in 10000ms.
   ❯ src/account-identity-preflight-stored-issuer.test.ts:238:3
   Test Files  1 failed | 192 passed (193)
        Tests  1 failed | 3666 passed | 10 skipped (3677)
  ```
- **This is a timeout, not an assertion.** The test writes 1,200 `sys_account` rows into a SQLite file, initialises the engine and walks the table twice. It sets no timeout of its own, so it uses vitest's 10 s default. In the same turbo run, `objectql`'s 466 test files were running at the same time.
- **The push run on the same commit was green** (40091915766, 11:56Z). It tests only the packages affected since the previous commit, and its logs do not show this file running live. The test was last changed in `4bf079c693` (#25056, 2026-10-21). None of the five plugin-auth commits since `e649c2d91e` touch it.
- **Why this matters now:** the release gate reads the newest completed schedule `CI` at or before a version commit, and the Version Packages PR #25640 (18.2.0) is open. A red schedule run at the commit before that merge refuses the release.

## Wanted

The test's budget is met under the full battery's load. Prefer making the fixture cheaper over raising the limit:
- Seed the 1,200 rows in one transaction or one multi-row insert, if `arrangeAccountTable` inserts row by row.
- Or span "several pages" with fewer rows, if the walk's page size can be set for the probe.

If the remaining cost is real work, give this one test an explicit timeout sized from its measured duration under the full battery, and say so in the test. ⛔ Never skip, disable or quarantine it; "flake" is not a root cause.

## Acceptance

- The test passes in the hourly full battery. Read it on the next schedule `CI` runs after the merge.
- Its local duration is recorded in the PR: before and after.

## Dedupe

The titles and bodies of every objectstack-ai/objectstack issue and PR updated since 2026-10-15, matched on `account-identity-preflight|stored-issuer|preflight … timed out|plugin-auth … timed out`. Hits: #25030 (the closed defect this test pins), #25056 (its fix PR) and #25109 (an unrelated bump). None is this timeout. **New.**
